The supplied patch excerpt is truncated, and the base excerpts do not include the changed regions. I therefore could not review the new section's full text, only the visible beginning.

The visible patch text consists of test instructions (swift test filters, a model-free plan check script, synthetic weights over loopback only). These touch T-041 (cross-tenant prefix cache and TTFT oracle) but are unchanged by this PR. The new Gemma TP documentation describes synthetic loopback tests only and makes no production-qualification claim, so there is no regression or invalidated assumption in the visible text.

Remaining question: the truncated remainder of the new section (head lines about 1260-1345) was not supplied. It could contain claims or commands, for example around env vars, ports, or enabling TP, that bear on TB-007 or TB-002. A reviewer with the full patch should confirm it keeps the 'synthetic only, no qualification' framing and does not instruct loosening of production gates such as DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE.
